intro: Your wallets: paying bills, cards and money held in other currencies.
start: Open a wallet account, then pay a bill or issue a card from it.

articles.title: Pay airtime, data, electricity or cable TV from a wallet
articles.summary: Pay a bill from one of your wallets, see the fee before you confirm, and keep the receipt and any token.
before: Your business must be verified for wallets, under Settings › Organisation › Verification.

steps.rest: and choose the wallet and what you are paying.
For electricity and government payments, press Check to see whose number it is and what is owed.
You see the amount, the fee, the total and what the wallet will have after.
If the connection drops, press Check status: it is never paid twice.

tips: Processing means the network has not answered yet. The money stays held; do not pay again.
To find an electricity token, open the row's Actions and choose View receipt.

articles.title: Give a team member a virtual card
articles.summary: Issue a card for a budget, put money on it, set its limits, and freeze it if it is lost.

steps.rest: and choose the wallet the card draws on and the member who holds it.
a budget line if you use one, and any limits.
You see the fee, the total and what the wallet will have after.
If the connection drops, press Check status: the card is never issued twice.
open the row's Actions and choose Put money on. Take money back gives it back to the wallet.

tips: Lost card? Open the row's Actions and choose Freeze. Unfreeze to use it again.
Show card details reveals the number, code and expiry, and hides them again after a minute.

articles.title: Put card and bill spending in an expense account
articles.summary: Each card payment and bill becomes an expense to categorise and keep a receipt for. Team members see their own.

steps.rest: on an expense to categorise, and choose Categorise.
and add a note if you want.
Upload a file or attach one from Drive.

articles.title: Get paid in dollars, euros or pounds
articles.summary: Open an account that receives a foreign currency into a wallet in that currency, and share its details with the payer.
before: You need a wallet in that currency. Open one on Wallets with New wallet.

steps.lead: Choose the wallet that holds it.
steps.rest: It must be a wallet in that currency. For euros, choose the country too.
The details to share appear as soon as it is open.

steps.lead: Send your details to the payer:
steps.rest: open the row's Actions, choose Show details to share, then Copy all or Share.

tips: Accounts can receive US dollars, euros, pounds, cedis and Kenyan shillings.
Opening means it is being set up. The details appear by themselves.
